name: @equin/plugin-debug-backend-crash
description: A backend death the gateway did not cause is a report: the gateway — the one process that sees every death and holds the dead process's stderr — files it in the report outbox, and main drains it. Declares the kinds and renders their evidence: backend-crash (a signal: Bun's panic line and bun.report link, where macOS wrote its symbolized crash report), backend-exit (an exit code nobody asked for: booting or serving) and backend-crash-loop (a worktree that keeps dying: its deaths and causes).
